messages:
alex: Hey eng-sre — trying to track down logs for request_id=abc1234 from yesterday (around ~15:40 PST). I looked in Console -> Logs but couldn't find anything matching that id. Any quick ways to get a direct link or CLI command?

priya: If you have the trace_id that's easiest: Console -> Observability -> Traces -> paste the trace id. For request_id we index it as `request.id` and `attributes.request_id`. In the console you can search `request.id:abc1234` in Logs.

liz: CLI option is quick too. Example:
```
# search logs by request id (UTC time range)
rwinf logs query --filter "attributes.request_id=\"abc1234\"" --from 2026-03-16T22:00:00Z --to 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z --pretty
```
That returns JSON lines you can grep for the trace_id field.

alex: nice, thanks. Is there a direct console URL I can paste into an email?

priya: Yep — Console supports URL queries, e.g.:
https://console.redwood.ai/logs?query=request.id%3Dabc1234&from=2026-03-16T22%3A00%3A00Z&to=2026-03-17T02%3A00%3A00Z
And for traces: https://console.redwood.ai/traces?query=trace.id%3D<TRACE_ID>

observability-bot: Ingestion note: found log batch containing attributes.request_id=abc1234 processed at 1769750300 (indexing complete).

sam: FYI we sample traces for high-volume public endpoints at 10% by default, so if you don't see a trace the log search is the fallback. If you expect the trace to exist, set sampling via the request header `x-rwinf-trace-sample: 1.0` for a repro.

liz: Also check edge/cdn logs — some requests get the request_id assigned at the edge. S3 path: `s3://redwood-logs/prod/cdn/2026/03/16/` and use `zcat | jq -r 'select(.request_id=="abc1234")'`.

alex: Great. One more ask: the /api/generate route alert is pretty noisy — it's firing on transient 429 bursts. Can we adjust the alert window/threshold?

priya: I can tweak the alert. Thinking `window=30m` and `error_rate_threshold=10%` for that route, with a suppress for known client throttling. @liz do you want a canary after change?

liz: Yes please. Also add a note in the alert playbook that 429s from our rate-limiter are expected occasionally. :memo:

priya: Will open a quick PR against infra-alerts repo and add the playbook note. Assigning to myself and adding canary for next deploy. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

alex: Thanks all — that should do it. If I still can't find the trace I'll post the exact timestamp and I'll let you know. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
